narrative.details:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, <lad/lass>. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
narrative.requestItemsText: Let us speak, champion. I can feel you carry something of the Light.

quests.name: Claws from the Deep
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs. Slay Gobbler and take his head. Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Reclaiming Goods
quests.objectiveText: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.

quests.name: Search More Hovels
quests.objectiveText: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Return the Statuette
quests.objectiveText: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Return the Statuette
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

quests.name: A Friend of the Family
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: A Friend of the Family
